# External engines

BootLoops builds on mature public software written by other people; please cite them
(column "Authors / please cite") whenever a BootLoops tool that drives their engine
contributes to a result. Engines used unmodified are installed from
their upstream projects, not vendored here. The engines we reimplemented ship in this
repository under [`../../upgrades/`](../../upgrades/); the engines we patched (Kira,
Blade, AMFlow.cpp) live in their own fork repositories — full source, upstream
license intact, and a `PATCHES.md` in each stating what changed and why — listed in
[`../../upgrades/ENGINES.md`](../../upgrades/ENGINES.md). Each tool's `GUIDE.md` under
`../../tools/` describes how it is used in the harness; this file is the shopping list,
with each engine's license as its upstream states it. None of the GPL-licensed engines
below is relicensed here: the harness runs them as separate programs, and the few tools
that import a GPL-licensed library at run time (pySecDec, SageMath with ore_algebra,
OSCAR) are noted in their rows; see `../../THIRD_PARTY.md` for the full statement.

For the patched forks the authoritative record of what changed versus upstream is the
`PATCHES.md` at the root of each fork repository (see
[`../../upgrades/ENGINES.md`](../../upgrades/ENGINES.md)); for the reimplemented engines
it is the `PATCHES.md` inside each [`../../upgrades/`](../../upgrades/) directory.
Usage notes live on each tool's page: open `../../tools/<name>/GUIDE.md` or browse the
Tools dropdown on the site.
